      "title": "Secondary endpoint lacks analysis",
      "quote": "AEs, serious adverse events (SAEs), and AEs leading to discontinuation or death, and severity of AEs as assessed by the National Cancer Institute (NCI) Common Terminology Criteria for Adverse Events version 5.0 (CTCAE v5.0)",
      "page": 33,
      "section": "2.2.2",
      "category": "completeness",
      "severity": "major",
      "explanation": "The safety endpoint is listed but no specific statistical analysis method is described for it in the Statistical Methods section; only general safety assessments are mentioned.",
      "fix": "Add a detailed analysis description for safety endpoints (e.g., incidence rates, severity grading, relationship) in Section 9.6."
    },
    {
      "title": "Secondary endpoint lacks analysis",
      "quote": "Duration of response, defined as the time from date of first documented response (CR or PR) to date of documented PD, based on RECIST v1.1 by BICR",

      "section": "2.2.2",
      "category": "completeness",
      "severity": "major",
      "explanation": "DOR is a secondary endpoint but no analysis method (e.g., Kaplan-Meier) is described in the efficacy analyses section.",
      "fix": "Specify the analysis method for DOR (e.g., Kaplan-Meier estimates, median with CI) in Section 9.5."
    },
    {
      "title": "Secondary endpoint lacks analysis",

    },
    {
      "title": "Secondary endpoint lacks analysis",
      "quote": "ORR, DOR, and PFS based on RECIST v1.1 and immune objective response rate, immune duration of response (iDOR), and immune progression-free survival (iPFS) based on iRECIST by Investigator assessment",
